attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The administration restored America's leadership at the UN by cooperating with partners when possible and respectfully disagreeing when necessary, reversing the previous administration's disdain for the UN.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President's leadership at the UN enabled progress on national security priorities, including getting Russia and China to implement the toughest UN sanctions ever on Iran and North Korea.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration will continue to build three pillars of American global leadership: a prosperous and inclusive economy, unsurpassed military strength, and an enduring commitment to advancing universal values.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
